tasks.title: Honest audit (first)
tasks.notes: Completed comprehensive audit of cc-studio-v1 codebase. Traced all 6 reported symptoms to specific stubs and empty handlers in CcStudioApp.kt; wrote docs/AUDIT.md.

tasks.title: Verification harness (before fixing, so the fixes can be proven)
tasks.notes: JVM tests for delete, add frame, view modes, effects stack, kfpack export validation, permissions, CI stub check, bundled demo generator.

tasks.title: Delete projects
tasks.notes: Implement project overflow delete with confirmation dialog, recursive folder deletion, and Delete all projects in Settings.

tasks.title: Add frames to pairs
tasks.notes: Implement 4 image sources (Gallery, Video frame, Camera, Files), two-step base/target flow, file copying, crop/ignore-region, and fit gating.

tasks.title: Permissions
tasks.notes: Just-in-time permission requests, explanation dialog, Settings Permissions screen, zero-network enforcement.

tasks.title: Add effects and the stack editor
tasks.notes: Effect library loader, Add effect modal picker, stack reordering, full parameter controls (scalar, bool, choice, color), presets, undo/redo.

tasks.title: View modes and the viewer
tasks.notes: 8 view modes (Result, Wipe with flip, Side by side, Top/bottom, Vs Target, Difference + gain, Channels, Scopes), pan/zoom viewer, frame strip.

tasks.title: Fit stage and Export stage, end to end
tasks.notes: Foreground service for fit solver with notification and metrics; 3 export modes (Add, Create new, Merge), MediaStore download saving, validation.

tasks.title: Release and proof (last)
tasks.notes: Automated release cc-studio-v2 via release.yml with signed APK and valid MOTIONSALT.kfpack asset, final report to Victor.
